where: molab marimo notebook (v2, converted from Experiments/notebook_v2_improved.ipynb); data at /home/marimo/pig_data
evaluation: leave-one-day-out over 7 recording days; macro-F1 over classes present in the held-out day; 'stored' = human-placed rows only, 'all_kept' = stored + gated

gate.note: one annotation step = one video frame (~0.17 s), so MAX_GAP is ~3 s and MAX_TRAIL ~1.7 s

data_fix: CSV had no raw_frame_index/elapsed_seconds; raw_frame_index = annotation_index (1,800 frames, 1,800 times.txt lines, max index 1799 in all 12 clips); elapsed_seconds from times.txt

models.geometry_motion_HGB: HistGradientBoosting(max_depth=4, lr=0.08, max_iter=150), balanced sample weights, 11 box geometry/motion/crowding features
models.frozen_emb_LR: MobileNetV3-Small ImageNet features (576-d, no fine-tuning), crop = box + 10% margin padded square 224px; median impute + standardise + LogisticRegression(C=0.02, balanced)
models.frozen_emb+geometry_LR: same LR on embeddings concatenated with geometry features
